dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed across the dorsal surface, specifically more concentrated toward the posterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between darker pigmented areas and the primary slate-grey canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel linear dark marks (rake marks) are visible on the lateral regions of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear scarring (rake marks) visible on both the left and right dorsal-lateral planes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, sharp dorsal ridge line extending along the central longitudinal axis.
